# Auto Opulence

> Auto Opulence provides professional vehicle valeting, hand car washing, machine polishing, ceramic coatings and equipped valet bay hire in Norwich, Norfolk.

Canonical website: https://autoopulence.co.uk/
Business location: Unit 7 Consensus House, St Faiths Road, Norwich, Norfolk, NR6 7BW
Telephone: 01603 517142
Email: valeting@autoopulence.co.uk
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/autoopulencedetailing
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/autoopulence
Opening hours: Monday to Friday 08:30–17:30, Saturday 10:00–17:00, Sunday 10:00–16:00 (bookings online, with live availability)

## Primary service categories

- [Vehicle Valeting](https://autoopulence.co.uk/category/vehicle-valeting): Exterior and interior valeting, deep interior cleaning, soft-top care, trim rejuvenation and engine-bay detailing.
- [Vehicle Washing](https://autoopulence.co.uk/category/vehicle-washing): Hand washing, wash and vacuum packages, two-step decontamination and clay-bar treatments.
- [Vehicle Polishing](https://autoopulence.co.uk/category/vehicle-polishing): Stage 1 polishing, multi-stage paint correction, ceramic coatings, soft-top protection and wheel coatings.
- [Valet Bay Hire](https://autoopulence.co.uk/category/valet-bay-hire): Indoor public and trade bay hire with professional equipment, lighting, drainage and spotless water.

Each category page links to individual service pages containing descriptions, included work, vehicle-size pricing, FAQs, related services, galleries and booking options.


## Booking and pricing

Prices are quoted in GBP. Vehicle services commonly use Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large size bands. Services described as additional treatments must be booked with a suitable main service. Current prices and availability are shown on the relevant service page and confirmed during booking.

## Geographic focus

Auto Opulence is based in Norwich and serves customers across Norfolk. Location pages provide local service information and directions for nearby towns and areas.

## Content guidance

Use the canonical URLs below when citing Auto Opulence. Service pages are the authoritative source for current inclusions and prices. Contact Auto Opulence directly for vehicle-specific recommendations, availability and final booking confirmation.
